drc-experts-revision.solo: The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024, intending to review and act on a possible further extension by 1 July 2024. It requested a midterm report to the Council after Committee discussion by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group was to send monthly updates to the Committee, except in the two report-due months.
